title: Understand a patient's record
description: Find an assigned patient and ask a follow-up about recorded allergies.

steps.title: Select the synthetic nurse
steps.processing: Find the nurse and active shift in SQLite.
steps.expected: Ava's identity is selected; no authentication is implied.

steps.title: Retrieve patient information
steps.input: Tell me about patient Rowan Demo
steps.processing: Join the patient's stored record to assigned tasks.
steps.expected: Stored patient context appears, with missing information stated honestly.

steps.title: Ask a follow-up
steps.processing: Reuse the patient reference saved in the voice checkpoint.
steps.expected: The answer uses the stored allergy field, not a demonstration response.

title: Confirm a coordination task update
description: Change a discharge-paperwork task only after explicit confirmation. This does not modify clinical orders.

steps.title: Select the nurse
steps.processing: Load the nurse's database scope.
steps.expected: Ava selected.

steps.title: Inspect the task
steps.input: What is the task status in room 701?
steps.processing: Read the assigned task's current status.
steps.expected: The displayed status matches SQLite.

steps.title: Propose an update
steps.input: Mark the task in room 701 completed
steps.processing: Stage an expiring confirmation without updating the task.
steps.expected: A confirmation prompt; database status remains unchanged.

steps.title: Confirm
steps.processing: Commit the task, event, receipt and checkpoint through existing services.
steps.expected: The local task is completed exactly once.

steps.title: Verify persistence
steps.input: What is the task status in room 701?
steps.processing: Read the updated stored record.
steps.expected: Completed status is returned.

title: Handle missing information safely
description: An incomplete record is not a negative clinical finding.

steps.title: Select the nurse
steps.processing: Resolve the stored nurse.
steps.expected: Ava selected.

steps.title: Ask about missing allergies
steps.input: What are the allergies for patient Taylor Demo?
steps.processing: Retrieve a patient whose allergy field is intentionally null.
steps.expected: Information unavailable, rather than claiming no allergies.

steps.title: Ask for an unavailable patient
steps.input: Tell me about patient Nobody Example
steps.processing: Search only the selected nurse's assigned patients.
steps.expected: No matching patient or a clarification; no invented record.

steps.title: Test the clinical boundary
steps.processing: Apply the existing clinical safety boundary.
steps.expected: Refusal to recommend treatment; no mutations.

title: Review, accept and finalize a handoff
description: Create a draft, explicitly accept responsibility as the incoming nurse, then finalize locally. No Epic note is published.

steps.title: Select the outgoing nurse
steps.processing: Resolve outgoing nurse context.
steps.expected: Ava selected.

steps.title: Prepare a draft
steps.processing: Read assignments and create a durable draft through existing handoff services.
steps.expected: Draft created; task ownership stays with Ava.

steps.title: Inspect assigned work
steps.input: What tasks are assigned to me?
steps.processing: Read current assignments after drafting.
steps.expected: Drafting has not transferred custody.

steps.title: Select the incoming nurse
steps.processing: Switch to the stored incoming nurse context without transferring tasks.
steps.expected: Zoe is selected; custody still requires confirmation.

steps.title: Propose custody acceptance
steps.processing: Stage acceptance of eligible carry-forward tasks.
steps.expected: Explicit confirmation is requested.

steps.title: Confirm custody
steps.processing: Persist assignment changes using the existing handoff service.
steps.expected: Eligible tasks now belong to Zoe.

steps.title: Propose local sign-off
steps.processing: Check accepted custody and unresolved discrepancies.
steps.expected: Confirmation is requested when prerequisites are satisfied.

steps.title: Confirm local sign-off
steps.processing: Persist local finalization without publishing to Epic.
steps.expected: Handoff is FINALIZED locally; external sync remains NOT_REQUESTED.

title: Interrupt and resume a workflow
description: Deliberately stop the deterministic orchestrator after committed reads, then resume from its database checkpoint.

steps.title: Interrupt after two reads
steps.processing: Run the existing MCP orchestrator and inject its supported interruption before step three.
steps.expected: A real checkpoint and interrupted workflow are shown.

steps.title: Resume the saved workflow
steps.processing: Reconcile saved state and execute remaining work through MCP.
steps.expected: The handoff draft completes without replaying already committed work.

title: An external integration is unavailable
description: Epic reads are deliberately disabled in the synthetic review environment. No network outage or live Epic success is fabricated.

steps.title: Call the disabled Epic tool
steps.processing: Invoke the existing get_epic_patient_context tool with reads disabled.
steps.expected: The tool reports a service error; no external request or mock patient is returned.

steps.title: Continue with explicit local context
steps.processing: Select a synthetic local nurse after the external error.
steps.expected: Local context works independently; Epic is still unavailable.

steps.title: Read local assignments
steps.input: What tasks are assigned to me?
steps.processing: Query the local synthetic database explicitly.
steps.expected: Local tasks are returned with no claim of Epic synchronization.
